mentions.name: Compiled agents
mentions.description: This tool takes a user's instructions, writes a versioned spec, and then generates a hybrid agent workflow of code plus LLM calls, protected with tests and evals. Because roughly 90% of the workflow is code, agents run much faster and cheaper (LLM steps are tightly scoped and use smaller models), and specs are turned into coded state machines for reliability.
mentions.problem: AI agents built from LLM calls alone tend to run slowly, cost more, and be unreliable.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Compiled agents: http://squig.com/

It takes your instructions, write a versioned spec, then generates a hybrid workflow of code+LLM calls and protects it with tests/evals

The result is that the agents run much faster (90% of it is code), cheaper (LLM steps are scoped tightly and uses smaller models) and reliably (specs get turned into coded state-machine)
